stem: Sadah would like to replace sentence 4 with a sentence that helps create a more effective opening for her story. Which of the following can replace sentence 4 and improve this paper's opening?

options.label: A
options.text: But Daniel didn’t know that the ants in this park were fire ants.

options.label: B
options.text: But his family had had picnics at many different parks in their old city.

options.label: C
options.text: But Daniel and his parents had seen a lot of ants at other picnics too.

options.label: D
options.text: But when ants came around, Daniel’s mom knew just what to do.
